items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Robert Allen Arthur? says of the two musicians that are writing, I was one of the two, the other he says was Louis Armstrong that he cared to read.

ctx.x: With a pitchfork so I went in the other direction. Well, it's the same thing. I was poked to write. I didn't one day get up and say, I'm going to be a writer, a jazz writer. Robert Allen Arthur? says of the two musicians that are writing, I was one of the two, the other he says was Louis Armstrong that he cared to read. He wouldn't care to read any other. And he's a writer.

So I feel complimented by it. It doesn't turn my head too much, because I realize that I better stick to playing music. I'm not going to make it writing. But it's good. I think the musician who can be audible should be, should say it. But don't get involved, don't suddenly think you've become a writer. You're a writer of a subject that you know something about. And if you can stick to that, you'll do well. And to the extent that well can be done doing that, that's fine.
